preconditions.description: The length of string S must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in string S must be lowercase Latin letters or digits.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(count * count for count in Counter(S).values()))
postconditions.description: The output must be the total number of ordered pairs (i, j) such that S[i] = S[j].
